summary: Retest of Cloudflare deployment readiness fix (env-file line split for APP_ENV/APP_URL). All 6 acceptance criteria verified: all_code.txt removed, /healthz returns 200 'ok' publicly, /api/health and /api/health/config carry Cache-Control: no-store on both localhost and the public Cloudflare-fronted URL (Cloudflare adds no-cache/must-revalidate but no-store is preserved), backend/.env now has APP_ENV and APP_URL on separate parsable lines, CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOYMENT.md documents permanent-URL requirement/CNAME/Full(strict)/DNS-only-first/API cache bypass/health checks/rollback with no secrets, and the public app flow (home + reviews) loads cleanly with backend Online.

checks.name: all-code-txt-removed
checks.evidence: ls /app/all_code.txt -> 'No such file or directory'; find /app/frontend -iname '*all_code*' -> no matches.

checks.name: healthz-public-curl
checks.evidence: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/healthz -> 200, body 'ok'. Public: GET https://deploy-hub-247.preview.emergentagent.com/healthz -> statusCode 200, contentType text/plain, body 'ok'. No secrets in response.

checks.name: api-health-cache-control-curl
checks.evidence: localhost: curl -D- http://localhost:8001/api/health and /api/health/config -> HTTP 200, cache-control: no-store (both). Public via Cloudflare: curl -D- https://deploy-hub-247.preview.emergentagent.com/api/health and /api/health/config -> HTTP/2 200, cache-control: 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' (no-store retained; Cloudflare appended extra directives, cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC).

checks.name: backend-env-format-review
checks.evidence: cat /app/backend/.env: MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, CORS_ORIGINS, APP_ENV=development, APP_URL=https://deploy-hub-247.preview.emergentagent.com each on its own line -> parsable as separate key=value pairs (previously APP_ENV and APP_URL were merged onto one line).

checks.criterion: Cloudflare-Rollout ist dokumentiert und sicher vorbereitet
checks.name: cloudflare-deployment-doc-review
checks.evidence: /app/CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOYMENT.md: requires permanent Emergent production hostname (not preview URL) before CNAME, CNAME 'Proxy: DNS only during hostname verification, then Proxied', SSL/TLS 'Full (strict)', /api/ cache-bypass rule, health checks for /healthz, /api/health, /api/health/config, and a Rollback section (Proxied -> DNS only). grep for token/secret/password/key patterns in the file -> none found.

checks.name: home-explains-offline-audit-flow + public-reviews-loaded-from-backend
checks.evidence: Both persisted browser checks reran against the public URL: 'home-explains-offline-audit-flow' PASSED (home page renders, no thrown errors); 'public-reviews-loaded-from-backend' PASSED (reviews list loads from backend). Screenshots captured for both, no console-blocking errors.

checks.name: backend-pytest-suite
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -> '5 passed in 0.45s' (test_tscheck_public_health.py, test_tscheck_reviews_api.py).

note: Retest mode: reused existing browser checks by name only (no script resend) and reran the existing backend pytest suite. New criteria in this briefing (all_code.txt removal, /healthz, no-store caching, .env formatting, CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOYMENT.md content) are static/config/API-level and were verified via direct curl (localhost and the public Cloudflare-fronted URL) and file review rather than new persisted artifacts, since they have no distinct UI surface beyond the already-covered home/reviews flow. Confirmed the spec_deviation note: Cloudflare appends 'no-cache, must-revalidate' to Cache-Control but 'no-store' remains present as required.
